en: A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a group of women and girls in traditional folk costumes standing on a balcony with decorative balusters. One person is holding a dark flag with a light horizontal stripe (resembling the Latvian flag in monochrome). The building façade behind them has tall arched windows and classical detailing. At the bottom of the card is printed text in Latvian.
